svg.title: KRO and Crossplane provision an app and its AWS resources on EKS
svg.desc: A developer applies StorageApp. KRO uses a ResourceGraphDefinition to create Deployment, Service, ServiceAccount and six Crossplane managed resources. Kubernetes runs the app Pod. AWS providers manage one S3 bucket and its settings, IAM role and policy, and an EKS Pod Identity association. The app reads and writes the same S3 bucket with short-lived Pod Identity credentials. EKS is prepared first using eksctl and CloudFormation. Gray arrows show resource management. Green arrows show app data access.
svg.text: One StorageApp creates an app and its AWS resources.
App and AWS providers use short-lived credentials from EKS Pod Identity.
No Crossplane Composition in this variant.
